model.name: Build.generateVersion
model.description: build.mjs FIRST step: read the ior:class:Config singleton (ScenarioIndex.get) -> const version = config.model.version (semver-validated via ConfigModel) REPLACING pkg.version as the build version input; then atomically stamp ALL derivatives from that one value — package.json version (write-back, surgical field), sw.js CACHE_NAME (regex stamp), build-manifest version field, and the __BUILD_VERSION__ bundle const. Consumers derive-equal by construction (INV-V1) so a rebuild can never desync them. Design-ahead (architect 23c7873da); expert points its impl here (marker on the generateVersion decl in build.mjs); NOT self-minted (#126).
